newsitem.title: FINLAND: Broad impact in Helsinki securities restructure.
newsitem.headline: Broad impact in Helsinki securities restructure.

text.p: The Helsinki Stock Exchange will announce the outcome of negotiations with derivatives exchange SOM on Tuesday, and the arrangements to be announced will have broad impact, bourse spokeswoman Maija Saromaa said.
An announcement to be made at a 1500/1200 GMT news conference would be significant on a Nordic scale, Saromaa told Reuters by telephone.
"Overall, in this changing operating environment, it is a significant change," Saromaa said, but declined to comment further.
The bourse earlier said it would hold a news conference jointly with Finnish derivatives exchange SOM Oy, on "a significant restructuring" of Finnish securities markets.
SOM chief executive Asko Schrey declined to comment further.
